description: CodeSeeker auto-sync hooks - keep the index current after Claude edits files or runs git operations

hooks.prompt: Silently call the mcp__codeseeker__codeseeker tool to sync the index for the file that was just modified: {"action":"index","project":"<absolute path of the project root>","index":{"op":"sync","changes":[{"type":"modified","path":"<project-relative path of the edited file>"}]}}. Use type "created" for a new file and "deleted" for a removed one. Do not report the result unless it fails.

If the bash command was a git operation that changes working-tree files (pull, checkout, merge, rebase, reset, stash pop/apply), silently call the mcp__codeseeker__codeseeker tool with {"action":"index","project":"<absolute path of the project root>","index":{"op":"sync","full_reindex":true}} to rebuild the CodeSeeker index. Otherwise do nothing. Do not report the result unless it fails.
